newsitem.title: USA: Fred Meyer seen selling assets - traders.
newsitem.headline: Fred Meyer seen selling assets - traders.

text.p: Fred Meyer Inc would be likely to divest some assets if it completed its proposed $720 million acquisition of Smith's Food & Drug Centers Inc, arbitragers said.
Arbitragers speculated the company will sell certain overlapping wearhousing operations, including some operations in Salt Lake City.
Smith's Food shares were up 2-1/2 in early trading, on news of the proposed acquisition, to 42-1/2, while Fred Meyer shares were down 1/4 to 41-5/8.

Fred Meyer earlier Monday said it would acquire Smith in a stock deal that values Smith shares at about $44 each. Fred Meyer would exchange 1.05 of its shares for each Smith share. It would also assume about $1.3 billion in Smith debt.
The merger would create a multi-regional supermarket and general merchandise retailing company with 265 major stores in 11 states.
